summary: Shell plc completed its acquisition of ARC Resources Ltd. on September 2, 2026, after receiving shareholder, court, and regulatory approvals. Per the Arrangement Agreement, ARC shareholders receive CAD$8.20 cash and 0.40247 Shell shares per ARC share, totaling approximately US$13.9 billion equity value, with US$2.5 billion net debt assumed making an enterprise value of ~US$16.5 billion. Shell issued ~US$10.6 billion in shares and paid US$3.3 billion cash. The deal adds ~370 kboe/d and is expected to be accretive from 2027. Integration execution and share delivery completion are key watch items.
